-- gui rebuild v10 (rakoof hitbox expander)
-- toggle: RightShift, the "-" button, or the round button on the left

local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.EvaCleanup then pcall(env.EvaCleanup) end

local conns = {}
local alive = true
local function track(c) table.insert(conns, c) return c end

local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS         = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local WS         = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TS         = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LP         = Players.LocalPlayer

-- shared state (declared up top so every section and cleanup can reach it)
local aiPauseUntil = 0
local standDist = 7
local dropsOn, tpDrop, aiOn, pickupOn, candyOn, speedOn, aimOn =
    false, false, false, false, false, false, false
local stopFly = function() end
local removePlatform = function() end
local stopAim = function() end
local restoreHitbox = function() end

-- runs a block safely so one broken feature can't stop the gui
local function section(name, fn)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then warn("[gui] '" .. name .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- ============ THEME ============
local C = {
    bg     = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 20),
    panel  = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 29),
    row    = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 38),
    rowHi  = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 52),
    off    = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 66),
    text   = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 245),
    dim    = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 160),
    a1     = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255),
    a2     = Color3.fromRGB(70, 180, 255),
    red    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 110),
}

local function new(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    if parent then o.Parent = parent end
    return o
end
local function corner(o, r)
    return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o)
end
local function gradient(o, rot)
    return new("UIGradient", {
        Color = ColorSequence.new(C.a1, C.a2),
        Rotation = rot or 0,
    }, o)
end
local function tween(o, t, props)
    TS:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

-- ============ SAFE MOUNT ============
local function mount(g)
    if syn and syn.protect_gui then pcall(syn.protect_gui, g) end
    local targets = {}
    if gethui then table.insert(targets, function() return gethui() end) end
    table.insert(targets, function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    table.insert(targets, function() return LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) end)
    for _, fn in ipairs(targets) do
        local ok, p = pcall(fn)
        if ok and p then
            local ok2 = pcall(function() g.Parent = p end)
            if ok2 and g.Parent == p then return p end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ============ DRAG ============
local function drag(frame, grip)
    grip.Active = true
    local dragging, start, startPos = false, nil, nil
    track(grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging, start, startPos = true, i.Position, frame.Position
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if not dragging then return end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local d = i.Position - start
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                       startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))
end

-- ============ WIDGETS ============
local function hover(b, base, hi)
    track(b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.12, {BackgroundColor3 = hi}) end))
    track(b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(b, 0.12, {BackgroundColor3 = base}) end))
end

        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,

        if not silent then

            if not ok then warn("[gui] " .. tostring(err)) end

    end
    track(row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not state) end))
    return set

local function slider(page, text, mn, mx, def, cb)
    local f = new("Frame", {

        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),

    corner(fill, 3)

        Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,

    }, bar)

    local hit = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -13),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
    }, bar)

    local dragging = false
    local function setFromX(x)
        local a = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        local v = math.floor(mn + (mx - mn) * a + 0.5)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
        val.Text = tostring(v)
        pcall(cb, v)
    end
    track(hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            setFromX(i.Position.X)
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            setFromX(i.Position.X)
        end
    end))
    track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))
end

-- ============ HELPERS ============
local function getRoot()
    local c = LP.Character
    return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function isRemote(d)
    return d:IsA("RemoteEvent") or d:IsA("RemoteFunction") or d:IsA("BindableEvent")
end

local function findRemote(names)
    local pool = {}
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        local hit = RS:FindFirstChild(n, true) or WS:FindFirstChild(n, true)
        if hit then table.insert(pool, hit) end
    end
    local rake = WS:FindFirstChild("the_rake", true)
    if rake then
        for _, d in ipairs(rake:GetDescendants()) do
            if isRemote(d) then table.insert(pool, d) end
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
        if isRemote(d) and d.Name:lower():find("startmode") then
            table.insert(pool, d)
        end
    end
    return pool
end

section("combat", function()
    -- ---- DROPS DATA ----
    -- add more drops here. "id" is the debug id from your snippet; debug ids
    -- change between sessions, so if the exact id isn't found it falls back
    -- to the first nil instance with that name.
    local DROPS = {
        {name = "Coin",       id = "1_200886"},
        {name = "TrainerCap", id = "1_239393"},
    }
    local dropChance = 25

    local function getNil(name, debugId)
        if not getnilinstances then return nil end
        for _, o in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
            if o.Name == name then
                if not debugId or o:GetDebugId() == debugId then
                    return o
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local nilCache = {}
    local function resolveDrop(d)
        if nilCache[d.name] then return nilCache[d.name] end
        local inst = getNil(d.name, d.id) or getNil(d.name)
        nilCache[d.name] = inst
        return inst
    end

    local function posOf(o)
        if typeof(o) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        local ok, p = pcall(function()
            if o:IsA("BasePart") then return o.Position end
            if o:IsA("Model") then return o:GetPivot().Position end
            if o:IsA("Tool") then
                local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                return h and h.Position
            end
        end)
        return ok and p or nil
    end

    local function tpTo(p, fromDrop)
        local root = getRoot()
        if root and p then
            root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            if fromDrop then aiPauseUntil = tick() + 1.5 end
        end
    end

    -- fires the SpawnDrop signal with the nil instance, like your snippets
    local function spawnDrop(d)
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then notify("SpawnDrop remote not found") return false end
        if not firesignal then notify("Your executor has no firesignal") return false end
        local inst = resolveDrop(d)
        if not inst then
            notify("Couldn't find '" .. d.name .. "' (needs getnilinstances)")
            return false
        end
        firesignal(ev.OnClientEvent, inst)
        return true
    end

    -- picks a random drop, fires it, then teleports to where it appeared
    local function rollDrop(fallbackPos)
        local d = DROPS[math.random(#DROPS)]
        local found
        local c = WS.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
            if o.Name == d.name then found = o end
        end)
        local ok = spawnDrop(d)
        task.wait(0.3)
        c:Disconnect()
        if ok and tpDrop then
            tpTo(posOf(found) or fallbackPos, true)
        end
    end

    -- teleport to drops the game spawns by itself
    local dropConn = nil
    local function bindDropListener()
        if dropConn then return true end
        local ev = RS:FindFirstChild("SpawnDrop")
        if not ev then return false end
        dropConn = ev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(obj)
            if not tpDrop then return end
            if typeof(obj) ~= "Instance" or not obj:IsDescendantOf(WS) then return end
            task.wait(0.1)
            tpTo(posOf(obj), true)
        end)
        track(dropConn)
        return true
    end

    -- watches enemies and rolls a drop when one dies
    local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function hookEnemy(m, hum)
        if hooked[m] then return end
        hooked[m] = true
        if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
        track(hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if not dropsOn then return end
            if math.random() * 100 > dropChance then return end
            local ok, pos = pcall(function() return m:GetPivot().Position end)
            task.spawn(rollDrop, ok and pos or nil)
        end))
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(1)
            if dropsOn then
                for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
                    if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character
                    and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                        local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if mh then hookEnemy(m, mh) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- ---- TARGETING (shared by Auto Rakoof, Aim Lock, Hitbox, Teleport to Rakoof) ----
    local aiTeleport, limitRange, hitRange, preferRakoof = true, false, 60, true

    local function validTarget(m)
        if not m or not m.Parent then return false end
        local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h and h.Health <= 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function partOf(m)
        return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or m.PrimaryPart
            or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end

    -- looks through a list for a model named like "rakoof"
    -- (falls back to a living "rake" model with a Humanoid, e.g. the_rake)
    local function scan(list)
        local fallback
        for _, d in ipairs(list) do
            if d:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(d) then
                local h = d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h or h.Health > 0 then
                    local n = d.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("rakoof") then
                        return d
                    elseif not fallback and h and n:find("rake") then
                        fallback = d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local rakoofCache, lastDeep = nil, 0
    local function getRakoof()
        if validTarget(rakoofCache) then return rakoofCache end
        rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetChildren())
        if not rakoofCache and tick() - lastDeep > 2 then
            lastDeep = tick()
            rakoofCache = scan(WS:GetDescendants())
        end
        return rakoofCache
    end

    local function nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
        local best, bestPart, bestD = nil, nil, math.huge
        for _, m in ipairs(WS:GetChildren()) do
            if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LP.Character then
                local mh = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local mr = m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if mh and mr and mh.Health > 0 and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) == nil then
                    local d = (mr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if (not useLimit or d <= hitRange) and d < bestD then
                        bestD, best, bestPart = d, m, mr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestPart
    end

    local function pickTarget(root, useLimit)
        if preferRakoof then
            local rk = getRakoof()
            local rp = rk and partOf(rk)
            if rp and (not useLimit or (rp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= hitRange) then
                return rk, rp
            end
        end
        return nearestEnemy(root, useLimit)
    end

    -- ---- AUTO RAKOOF ----
    label(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof")
    local aiCon = nil

    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Rakoof", function(v)
        aiOn = v
        if aiCon then aiCon:Disconnect(); aiCon = nil end

        aiCon = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if tick() < aiPauseUntil then return end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end

            local m, mr = pickTarget(root, limitRange)
            if not m or not mr then return end

            if aiTeleport then
                local target = mr.Position + (mr.CFrame.LookVector * -1) * standDist + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(target, mr.Position)
            end
            local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
        end)
        track(aiCon)
    end)

    local setRF = toggle(pCombat, "Rakoof First", function(v) preferRakoof = v end)
    setRF(true)
    local setTPEnemy = toggle(pCombat, "Teleport to Enemy", function(v) aiTeleport = v end)
    setTPEnemy(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "Limit Hit Range", function(v) limitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hit Range (studs)", 5, 500, hitRange, function(v) hitRange = v end)
    slider(pCombat, "Stand Distance", 3, 20, standDist, function(v) standDist = v end)

    -- ---- RAKOOF HITBOX ----
    label(pCombat, "Rakoof Hitbox")
    local hbOn, hbAll, hbShow, hbSize = false, false, true, 25
    local hbOriginal = {}   -- [part] = original properties
    local hbModel = nil

    local function hbRestore()
        for part, o in pairs(hbOriginal) do
            if part and part.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    part.Size = o.Size
                    part.Transparency = o.Transparency
                    part.CanCollide = o.CanCollide
                    part.Massless = o.Massless
                end)
            end
        end
        hbOriginal = {}
        hbModel = nil
    end
    restoreHitbox = hbRestore

    local function hbApply(part)
        if not hbOriginal[part] then
            hbOriginal[part] = {
                Size = part.Size,
                Transparency = part.Transparency,
                CanCollide = part.CanCollide,
                Massless = part.Massless,
            }
        end
        local o = hbOriginal[part]
        local want = o.Size + Vector3.new(hbSize, hbSize, hbSize)
        if part.Size ~= want then part.Size = want end
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.Massless = true
        part.Transparency = hbShow and math.max(0.55, o.Transparency) or o.Transparency
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while alive do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if hbOn then
                local m = getRakoof()
                if m then
                    if hbModel ~= m then
                        hbRestore()
                        hbModel = m
                    end
                    if hbAll then
                        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
                            if p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(hbApply, p) end
                        end
                    else
                        local rp = partOf(m)
                        if rp then pcall(hbApply, rp) end
                    end
                elseif hbModel then
                    hbRestore() -- Rakoof is gone
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    toggle(pCombat, "Expand Rakoof Hitbox", function(v)
        hbOn = v
        if not v then
            hbRestore()
            return
        end
        if not getRakoof() then
            notify("Rakoof not found yet - will apply when he spawns")
        end
    end)
    slider(pCombat, "Hitbox Size", 1, 100, hbSize, function(v) hbSize = v end)
    local setHbShow = toggle(pCombat, "Show Hitbox", function(v)
        hbShow = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies with the new look next tick
    end)
    setHbShow(true)
    toggle(pCombat, "All Parts", function(v)
        hbAll = v
        if hbOn then hbRestore() end -- reapplies for the new mode next tick
    end)

    -- ---- AIM LOCK ----
    label(pCombat, "Aim Lock")
    local aimStrength, aimHead = 100, false
    local aimTarget, aimPart, aimAt = nil, nil, 0
    local AIM_BIND = "eva_aim_" .. tostring(math.random(1000, 9999))

    local function aimStep()
        local cm = WS.CurrentCamera
        local root = getRoot()
        if not cm or not root then return end
        -- re-pick the target a few times a second instead of every frame
        if tick() - aimAt > 0.25 or not (aimPart and aimPart.Parent) then
            aimAt = tick()
            aimTarget, aimPart = pickTarget(root, false)
        end
        if not aimPart then return end
        local pos = aimPart.Position
        if aimHead and aimTarget then
            local h = aimTarget:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then pos = h.Position end
        end
        local goal = CFrame.new(cm.CFrame.Position, pos)
        local a = aimStrength / 100
        cm.CFrame = (a >= 1) and goal or cm.CFrame:Lerp(goal, a)
    end

    stopAim = function()
        aimOn = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AIM_BIND) end)
    end

        end)

    slider(pCombat, "Lock Strength", 5, 100, aimStrength, function(v) aimStrength = v end)
    toggle(pCombat, "Aim at Head", function(v) aimHead = v end)

    label(pCombat, "Teleport")
    button(pCombat, "Teleport to Rakoof", function()

        if not m then notify("Rakoof not found") return end

    toggle(pCombat, "Enemy Drops", function(v) dropsOn = v end)

    -- ---- AUTO PICKUP + AUTO CANDY ----
    label(pCombat, "Automation")

    local function touch(root, part)
        if firetouchinterest then
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 0)
            pcall(firetouchinterest, root, part, 1)
        elseif not part.Anchored then
            pcall(function() part.CFrame = root.CFrame end)
        end
    end

    -- picks up tools plus parts named drop / coin / item
    toggle(pCombat, "Auto Pickup", function(v)
        pickupOn = v
        if not v then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            while pickupOn and alive do

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local safePlat, safeOrigPos, rakeConn
local oldLight = {}

-- GUI colors
local guiC,textC,lineC = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)

-- Helpers
local function charHRP() local c=P.Character or P.CharacterAdded:Wait() return c,c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
local function clickSound(p)
    local s=Instance.new("Sound",p)
    s.SoundId="rbxassetid://9118823107"; s.Volume=1; s:Play()
    game.Debris:AddItem(s,1)
end

local function hitRake()
    local c,hrp=charHRP()
    local npc=workspace:FindFirstChild("The_Rake")
    if not npc then return end
    local h=npc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not h or h.Health<=0 then return end
    local nRP=npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if nRP then
        local old=hrp.Position
        hrp.CFrame=CFrame.new(nRP.Position - nRP.CFrame.LookVector*3 + Vector3.new(0,2,0), nRP.Position)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VU:Button1Down(Vector2.new(0,0)); VU:Button1Up(Vector2.new(0,0))
        task.wait(S.tpDelay)
        hrp.CFrame=CFrame.new(old)
    end
end

local function resetToggles()
    S.auto=false; S.safe=false; S.cam=false; S.full=false
    if rakeConn then rakeConn:Disconnect() rakeConn=nil end
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom
    if P.Character and P.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        cam.CameraSubject=P.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    if safePlat then safePlat:Destroy() safePlat=nil end
    safeOrigPos=nil
    if oldLight.Brightness then
        Lighting.Brightness=oldLight.Brightness
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=oldLight.OutdoorAmbient
        Lighting.FogEnd=oldLight.FogEnd
    end
end

-- Create Hub
local function createHub()
    if P.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ErickzzzHubGui") then P.PlayerGui.ErickzzzHubGui:Destroy() end
    local SG=Instance.new("ScreenGui",P.PlayerGui); SG.Name="ErickzzzHubGui"
    local F=Instance.new("Frame",SG)
    F.Size=UDim2.new(0,180,0,300); F.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-90,0.5,-150)
    F.BackgroundColor3=guiC; F.Active=true; F.Draggable=true
    Instance.new("UICorner",F).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
    Instance.new("UIStroke",F).Color=lineC

    local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",F)
    title.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,25); title.BackgroundTransparency=1
    title.Text="👑 Erickzzz Hub"; title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextColor3=textC; title.TextScaled=true

    local SF=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame",F)
    SF.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-130); SF.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,25)

    -- Hit The Rake

    hitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        hitBtn.Text=oldText; S.inCD=false
    end)

    -- Auto Hit

            spawn(function() while S.auto do hitRake() task.wait(S.hitCD) end end)
        else autoBtn.Text="Auto Hit: OFF"; autoBtn.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30) end
    end)

    -- Safe Mode
    local safeBtn=btn("Safe Mode 🛡️: OFF")
    safeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local c,hrp=charHRP()
        S.safe=not S.safe

        end
    end)

    -- Camera Lock

        if not npc or not npc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

        if S.cam then
            camBtn.Text="Camera: ON"; cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            rakeConn=RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

                    cam.CFrame=CFrame.new(nRP.Position - nRP.CFrame.LookVector*8 + Vector3.new(0,4,0), nRP.Position)
                else resetToggles() end
            end)
        else
            camBtn.Text="Camera: OFF"; cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.CameraSubject=P.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if rakeConn then rakeConn:Disconnect() rakeConn=nil end
        end
    end)

    -- Full Bright
    local fullBtn=btn("Full Bright: OFF")
    fullBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        S.full=not S.full
        if S.full then
            fullBtn.Text="Full Bright: ON"
            oldLight.Brightness=Lighting.Brightness
            oldLight.OutdoorAmbient=Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
            oldLight.FogEnd=Lighting.FogEnd
            Lighting.Brightness=2
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            Lighting.FogEnd=100000
        else

            if oldLight.Brightness then
                Lighting.Brightness=oldLight.Brightness
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=oldLight.OutdoorAmbient
                Lighting.FogEnd=oldLight.FogEnd
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Teleport Delay TextBox
    local lblTP=Instance.new("TextLabel",F)
    lblTP.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); lblTP.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-95)

    local tbTP=Instance.new("TextBox",F)
    tbTP.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,25); tbTP.Position=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-75)

    tbTP.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; tbTP.TextScaled=true; tbTP.Text=tostring(S.tpDelay)

        local val=tonumber(tbTP.Text)

    end)

    -- Hit Cooldown TextBox

    lblCD.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); lblCD.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-60)

    local tb=Instance.new("TextBox",F)
    tb.Size=UDim2.new(1,-10,0,25); tb.Position=UDim2.new(0,5,1,-35)
    tb.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30); tb.TextColor3=textC
    tb.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; tb.TextScaled=true; tb.Text=tostring(S.hitCD)
    Instance.new("UICorner",tb).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    tb.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local val=tonumber(tb.Text)
        if val and val>0 then S.hitCD=val else tb.Text=tostring(S.hitCD) end
    end)
end

-- Initial GUI
createHub()

    createHub()
